# FlintRay

> FlintRay shows companies what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity tell their buyers, who gets recommended instead and why, then works the fixes until the company is in the answer.

- Method: each buyer situation runs as a three-turn conversation (the problem, the constraints, then "which companies would you contact?") in all four assistants, in the apps buyers use. The model behind every answer and the pages it read are recorded. A company counts as recommended only when the assistant's own words name it.
- Free audit: 15 buyer situations, three turns each, four assistants, a private report and a walkthrough call.
- Lens Monitor: from $2,500 a month. Situations rerun every two weeks, a live report, sources, a fix plan.
- Lens Engage: from $6,500 a month. Monitor rerun weekly, plus FlintRay writes and places the fixes.
- Partners: white-label delivery under a partner's brand. Pricing on request.
